title: GRAIL finds large lunar caverns and lava tubes

tellings.quote:
But NASA has also um
imaged the subsurface of the moon using
a probe called Grail

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels' podcast says that in the 2010s NASA used a probe called GRAIL to see beneath the surface of the Moon. According to the guest, it found large caverns and lava tubes, long tunnels left behind by ancient lava flows. If true, it would mean the Moon has big hollow spaces under its surface.
